motion.$description: Machine motion: short, linear or decelerating, never elastic. Motion reveals a change of state; it never carries meaning that the still state does not show. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration but `blink` drops to 0 ms (src/base.css).

tick.$description: A counter stepping to its next value

step.$description: One segment of a bar lighting up or going dark

swap.$description: A shape changing state: tone, fill, border

draw.$description: A line or a new log entry appearing

lock.$description: A marker settling on its target

sweep.$description: A scan passing over a panel

trace.$description: A plot drawing its whole line

blink.$description: Period of an alarm blink: one flash per second, under the WCAG 2.3.1 limit of three

linear.$description: Scans, sweeps and anything that moves at machine speed

out.$description: Arrivals: fast start, settles without overshoot
